title: 第25章 本宫怎会对杂役产生这种情绪第26章 掌门大人你好香啊
content_zh:
“杂役部林陌，见过掌门大人。”
见到柳紫嫣，林陌还是一如往常那般问候了一声。
“炼气八重？看上去也年轻了一些，这老奴才身上究竟发生了什么？”
柳紫嫣打量着林陌，心中不免感到有些好奇和惊讶。
短短一个多月时间，从炼气二重直冲炼气八重。
这般恐怖的速度，即便是当年的她也望尘莫及！
“没道理，若这老奴才真有如此妖孽的资质，当初又岂会成为杂役？”
但眼下，林陌炼气八重的修为，又不可能作得了假。
“难道说，他是某位超级大能的轮回转世，直到近期方才觉醒？如若不然，凭他那废柴都不如的资质和悟性，怎么可能能够如此顺利的修成阳卷的阴阳邪魔功？”
若林陌真是某位超级大能转世，按理说她应该能看出一些端倪才对。
但...
柳紫嫣左看右看，林陌完全没有一点超级大能转世的迹象。
“掌门大人，您在看什么？”
见柳紫嫣一直在盯着他不说话，林陌不免感到有些尴尬。
柳紫嫣左思右想都想不明白，干脆直接问：“炼气八重，你倒是给本宫解释解释，这是如何一回事。”
“呃...”
林陌思索了片刻，答道：“禀掌门大人，老夫也不知怎的，练着练着就突破了。”
“您说，老夫有没有可能，真的是天才？”
“你若是天才，世上便没有废柴了。”
柳紫嫣当即否定了林陌的说法。

“......”
“那老夫便不知了，不过...掌门大人，我好像不是您口中说的烂泥，我真能扶上墙。”
林陌稍微有点嘚瑟道。
他在试探柳紫嫣对自己的态度。
“不过刚被糊上墙根罢了，有何可嘚瑟的？”
柳紫嫣毫不留情地打击道：“你既修成了阴阳邪魔功阳卷，想来对这部功法有所了解，跟本宫说说看，你的了解程度有多深。”
“是，掌门大人！”
林陌正儿八经地答道：“老夫理解得没错的话，阴阳邪魔功应当是一部双修功法，顾名思义，即是要双修方能发挥出这部功法的真正效果。”
柳紫嫣美眸微眯。
说得很好，下次别说了。
你这跟说了一堆废话又有何区别？
但林陌还有下文：“可惜，自修成阴阳邪魔功以来，老夫一直是孤身一人修行，因此未能发挥阴阳邪魔功该有的修炼成效。”
“是么？”
柳紫嫣语气淡漠道。
感受着从柳紫嫣身上散发出来的，那股令人不寒而栗的骇人气息。
林陌硬着头皮颔首道：“是！”
然而！
话音说完，却见柳紫嫣长袖一挥。
林陌再次被拍飞，整个人如同断线的纸鸢一般。
content_en:
"Lin Mo, from the handyman department, has met the leader."
When Lin Mo saw Liu Ziyan, he greeted her as usual.
"Eighth level of Qi refining? He looks a little younger. What happened to this old servant?"
Liu Ziyan looked at Lin Mo, feeling a little curious and surprised.
In just over a month, he went from the second level of Qi refining to the eighth level of Qi refining.
Such terrifying speed was beyond her reach even back then!
"It makes no sense. If this old slave really had such evil qualifications, how could he have become a handyman in the first place?"
But at the moment, Lin Mo's cultivation at the eighth level of Qi Refining is impossible to fake.
"Could it be that he is the reincarnation of a certain super powerful person who has only awakened recently? If not, how could he be able to master the Yin and Yang Demonic Skills of Yang Juan so smoothly with his inferior qualifications and understanding?"
If Lin Mo is really the reincarnation of a super powerful person, it stands to reason that she should be able to see some clues.
But...
Liu Ziyan looked left and right, and there was no sign of Lin Mo's superpower reincarnation at all.
"Sir, what are you looking at?"
Seeing Liu Ziyan staring at him without speaking, Lin Mo couldn't help but feel a little embarrassed.
Liu Ziyan couldn't figure it out even after thinking about it, so she simply asked directly: "Eighth level of Qi refining, you should explain to me what is going on."
"Uh..."
Lin Mo thought for a moment and replied: "Thank you, Master, I somehow managed to break through with practice."
"Do you think it's possible that I'm really a genius?"
"If you were a genius, there would be no losers in the world."
Liu Ziyan immediately denied Lin Mo's statement.
"..."
"I don't know about that, but... Mr. Leader, I don't seem to be the mud you say. I can really hold up the wall."
Lin Mo said a little sarcastically.
He was testing Liu Ziyan's attitude towards him.
"It's just that it was stuck on the wall. What's there to complain about?"
Liu Ziyan struck mercilessly: "Since you have completed the Yin Yang Evil Demon Gong Yang Scroll, I think you have some understanding of this technique. Tell me how deep your understanding is."
"Yes, Master!"
Lin Mo replied seriously: "If I understand correctly, the Yin Yang Evil Demon Technique should be a dual cultivation method. As the name suggests, dual cultivation is required to achieve the true effect of this technique."
Liu Ziyan narrowed her beautiful eyes.
Very well said, don't say it next time.
What's the difference between this and talking a lot of nonsense?
But Lin Mo had something else to say: "Unfortunately, since I mastered the Yin-Yang Demonic Kung Fu, I have been practicing alone, so I have not been able to achieve the expected cultivation results of the Yin-Yang Demonic Kung Fu."
"Really?"
Liu Ziyan said in an indifferent tone.
Feeling the chilling and terrifying aura emanating from Liu Ziyan's body.
Lin Mo nodded bravely and said, "Yes!"
However!
After she finished speaking, Liu Ziyan waved her sleeves.
Lin Mo was shot away again, and his whole body was like a broken kite.
